Self.Wiki: A Wwise spatial audio room. The game sends the box to Wwise as a room: its walls become sound-reflecting geometry, and sounds inside it get the room's reverb, while sounds heard through the walls are muffled by its Occlusion. Reverb Aux Bus, Reflect Texture and Reflect Aux Bus pick rows of the WwiseValueToStrParam params, which name the Wwise reverb bus, wall material and reflection bus. The box must be a Box shape: the game skips a room of any other shape. Retail: only 3 rooms, one each in m00_10_00_00 (the garage), m50_00_00_00 (one box that covers the whole map) and m50_50_00_00. Elden Ring and Nightreign use this region type differently (as an occlusion box).

BoxNumber.Wiki: The room's number. The game names the room's Wwise geometry after it (Geometry_0000 for 0) and builds the room's Wwise ID from it, so keep it different from the map's other rooms. Retail: 0, 100 and 0 (in different maps).

ReverbAuxBusType.Wiki: The reverb used for sounds in the room: a row of WwiseValueToStrParam_ReverbAuxBusType, whose rows name the Wwise reverb buses (0 Room0_Dry, 1 to 8 Room1_Little up to Room8_HugeLarge, and more). Not seen read in the game's update code, so how strongly it applies was not traced. Retail: 2 (m50_50_00_00), 10 (m50_00_00_00), 11 (garage).

ReverbLevel.Wiki: How much reverb the room adds, in percent (100 = full). Only seen read by the sound debug display, so its in-game effect was not confirmed. Retail: 100, or 80 in the garage.

Occlusion.Wiki: How much the room's walls block sound passing through them, in percent: 100 blocks it fully, 0 lets it through. Applied to every wall of the room. Retail: 20, or 100 in the garage.

ReflectTextureType.Wiki: The material of the room's walls, which decides how they reflect sound: a row of WwiseValueToStrParam_ReflectTextureType (0 MoonSurface, 1 Concrete, 2 Iron, 3 Water, 4 Snow/Dirt). Retail: 1 Concrete (m50_50_00_00), 2 Iron (garage), 4 Snow/Dirt (m50_00_00_00).

ReflectAuxBusType.Wiki: The reflection bus for the room: a row of WwiseValueToStrParam_ReflectAuxBusType (0 Reflect_Preset; rows 1 to 3 are named No). Where the game applies it was not traced. Retail: 0 on every room.

ReflectLevel.Wiki: How strongly the room's walls reflect sound, in percent (100 = full). Only seen read by the sound debug display, so its in-game effect was not confirmed. Retail: 100, or 0 in m50_00_00_00 (the map-wide room).

BuildWallsOnEntry.Wiki: When set, the room's walls are not created when the map loads. Instead they are created while the listener is inside the box and removed again when it leaves, which saves sound processing for rooms the player is rarely in. 0 = walls always present. Retail: 0 on every room.

OverrideWidth.Wiki: Replaces the Box's width for the room when above 0. -1 keeps the shape's width. Retail: -1 on every room.

OverrideDepth.Wiki: Replaces the Box's depth for the room when above 0. -1 keeps the shape's depth. Retail: -1 on every room.

OverrideHeight.Wiki: Replaces the Box's height for the room when above 0. -1 keeps the shape's height. Retail: -1 on every room.

Shape.Wiki: Must be a Box: the game ignores a room of any other shape. The box's size gives the room's walls unless an Override size is set. Retail: garage 50 x 50 x 50, m50_50_00_00 85 x 125 x 285, m50_00_00_00 120,000 x 50,000 x 180,000 (the whole map).

Position.Wiki: Where the room is placed: the bottom centre of the box.

Rotation.Wiki: Turns the room, in degrees. Retail: unturned on every room.

RegionID.Wiki: The region's ID. The game keeps every region of the map in a table keyed by it, so keep it different from the map's other regions. Retail: 8000 on all three rooms.

ActivationPartName.Wiki: A part that the region depends on. Whether the sound room uses it was not traced. Retail: empty on every room.

EntityID.Wiki: Identifies this region in event scripts. Whether event scripts can switch the room off was not traced. Retail: 0 on every room.

EntityGroupIDs.Wiki: Lets event scripts address several regions at once. Not traced for this type. Retail: empty on every room.

ChildRegionNames.Wiki: No known effect for this region type. Retail: empty.

UnkC08.Wiki: No known effect for this region type. Retail: -1.
